ci.prTitle: Close PostgreSQL fixture connections before safe database cleanup

gitCommit.subject: Wait for actual PostgreSQL backend closure before fixture cleanup
gitCommit.body:
Wait for actual PostgreSQL backend closure before fixture cleanup

Fix the independently diagnosed SQLSTATE57P01 from original main CI43599951215. Observe pg_stat_activity for the owned loopback fixture, refuse cleanup on a bounded timeout, and DROP without FORCE. Add a held-connection counterproof. No runtime or canonical SQL changes.
